description: Source code for Opus audio decoder implementation, including initialization, decoding, and reset functionalities, using the Opus multistream decoder library.

classes.name: OpusAudioDecoder
classes.description: Class implementing an Opus audio decoder with methods for initialization, decoding, resetting, and cleanup.

classes.name: DecodedAudio
classes.description: Referenced as a scoped_refptr within the decoder, representing decoded audio data.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the output and error callback functions for decoding.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Processes input buffers to decode audio data, handling multiple buffers and scheduling.

methods.name: DecodePendingBuffers
methods.description: Decodes queued input buffers until a minimum number is processed.

methods.name: DecodeInternal
methods.description: Performs the actual decoding of a single input buffer using the Opus library.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals the end of the audio stream, adding EOS marker.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Creates and initializes the Opus multistream decoder based on channel info.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves decoded audio data and sample rate.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and clears buffers.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the decoder instance is valid.

methods.name: GetSampleType
methods.description: Returns the sample type used by the decoder (int16 or float32).
